headline: Peru MEF Advances Public-Private Dialogue to Boost Amazon Investments
summary: Peru's Ministry of Economy and Finance led executive sessions to strengthen public-private coordination, aiming to unlock investments and promote sustainable productive development in the forestry and Amazonian sectors.
why: Government-led executive platforms focused on regional infrastructure and resource development aim to remove bureaucratic bottlenecks for foreign and domestic capital deployment.

impacts.name: Forestry and Amazon development sector
impacts.why: Streamlined public-private coordination is intended to facilitate sector investments and regulatory clearance.
